relationship_to_prior_programme.rule: The failed joint time-space gate is not relaxed or reinterpreted. This follow-up asks a different temporal-only biological question and freezes its design before any real family x trait memory effect is opened.

question: Across vascular plant families and traits, is the strength of phylogenetic trait-memory loss primarily a property of the trait itself or of the evolutionary lineage in which the trait is expressed?

competing_architectures.trait_dominant: The same trait tends to lose phylogenetic memory at similar rates across families; between-trait variance exceeds between-family variance.
competing_architectures.lineage_dominant: Families show broadly fast or slow trait-memory loss across multiple traits; between-family variance exceeds between-trait variance.

trait_universe.selection_rule: All preclassified BIEN traits are eligible. Do not select traits by observed memory effect.

eligibility.continuous_validity: all eligible nonmissing values parse as finite numeric; exactly one nonempty unit; species state = median
eligibility.categorical_validity: blank/null unit; species state = unique modal category; tied-mode species excluded
eligibility.reason: This is a new temporal-only study. Spatial eligibility from the prior joint programme is neither required nor used for selection.

crossed_analysis_core.construction: Start from all temporal-informativeness PASS family x trait systems, then iteratively remove traits represented in fewer than 5 families and families represented by fewer than 2 traits until stable.
crossed_analysis_core.fail_rule: If the stabilized crossed core has fewer than 12 families, fewer than 4 traits, or more than one connected component, stop the primary variance-partition analysis before opening real memory effects.

temporal_species_state.continuous: median of valid measurements per species

memory_effect.null_mean: exactly zero under complete whole-state label permutation over all unordered pairs
memory_effect.direction: larger positive rho = faster loss of trait similarity with phylogenetic separation
memory_effect.prune_only_sensitivity: same estimator on GBOTB native tips only

primary_model.independence: family and trait are crossed grouping factors; no species are treated as macroevolutionary replicates
primary_model.uncertainty: 2000 parametric bootstrap replicates under fixed seed 20261003

secondary_predeclared: Report semantic_class fixed effect but do not use it to drop systems.
Repeat the primary model replacing S3 rho by prune-only rho on the identical admitted system set.
Report family and trait BLUPs descriptively only after the global variance architecture is estimated; do not rank/select systems for new primary claims.
hard_nonclaims: No spatial turnover claim is made.
No inference that temporal and spatial turnover share a mechanism.
No use of the prior joint-route spatial failures as biological zeroes.
No outcome-driven trait or family deletion.
No third-source rescue if BIEN temporal-only eligibility fails.
